instruction.text: One slice of pizza is 1/8 of the total pizza. Count up in slices of pizza, writing the fractions in their simplest form.
A slice of bread makes up 1/10 of a loaf. Count up the number of slices of bread, writing the fractions in their simplest form.

Jacob does a quiz with his friend Bethany. In this game you start on 0 points and earn 0.2 points for every question answered correctly. Jacob answers all 7 questions correctly. Count how many points he has got in total.
Bethany on the other hand answers all 7 questions incorrectly. Each incorrect answer results in a loss of 0.3 points. Count how many points she has lost in total.
